title: The dark room
starting_code: # The room is dark. Light it, find the key, and open the door.
hints: In the dark, `find_nearest` finds nothing far away: light the room first.
After `kirra`, print where the key lies, and walk to it.
The door is locked: carry its key, and stand right beside it.
intro: This storeroom has no lamp, and I am not lending you mine. The key to the far door is in here, somewhere.
